answer: Money sits in escrow until a jury grades the work. The jury must span unrelated subnetworks, so one operator cannot supply the votes. Each identity gets 2 graded jobs per epoch, which makes bulk farming pointless. A gale of duplicate accounts earns no more than two payouts each and still posts a bond, so the tide of new names never turns into income. The precise cost for 40 clones is 40 funded wallets and 120 outside signatures, against at most 80 payouts. The shale stays cold for the rest.
